name: pre-mortem-stateless
description: Runs a pre-mortem on a plan, PRD or brief you paste into the chat: it assumes the plan already failed and writes the 5-7 most likely failure stories, each tied to a specific line of your plan (the assumption it breaks), with likelihood, impact, an early-warning sign and a mitigation, ranked by likelihood x impact in code. A small CrewAI crew does it: a failure-mode finder works through four lenses (premise, delivery, downside, design), then a skeptical reviewer re-rates likelihood and impact and merges duplicates; a story that can't quote a line of your plan is dropped as generic. Also lists the unstated assumptions and questions for the team. Follow-ups: only the top 3, go deeper on one, show the plan lines, as json. It keeps nothing between messages: follow-ups work on the plan and pre-mortem still in the recent conversation, and a long plan from much earlier may need re-pasting. It reads only what you paste, never invents team facts and sends nothing. Not for general risk lists or writing the plan.

skills.name: Pre-mortem a plan
skills.description: The 5-7 most likely ways the pasted plan fails, each anchored on a plan line, ranked by likelihood x impact, with early warnings, mitigations, unstated assumptions and questions for the team.
examples: Pre-mortem this PRD, team of 4, launch Dec 15: <paste the PRD>
